coordinate_note: Coordinates are the raw exact rational QF_LRA model. They are intentionally not decimalized or numerically rounded.
parameterization: Each shape has apex p, positive radius r, and equal-norm rational directions u,v. Its rays are p+t*u and p+t*v for t>0; its crossbar is p+r*u+t*(v-u), 0<t<r.
conclusion: This exact rational colored-K8,8 construction has 904 globally distinct proper crossings and 937 regions. Together with the unconditional Mantel upper bound, it proves a(16)=937.
